questions.stem: Why would a person with anaemia (too few red blood cells) feel tired and breathless?

options.text: Their blood cannot clot properly after an injury
Less haemoglobin means less oxygen is delivered to cells for respiration
Their plasma cannot dissolve enough nutrients

questions.explanation: With fewer red blood cells, there is less haemoglobin available to carry oxygen. Cells receive less oxygen for aerobic respiration, leading to fatigue, and the body tries to compensate by increasing breathing rate.
